description: Creates a new Cognigy.AI knowledge store for RAG content. Knowledge stores contain sources (documents) that AI Agents can search to answer questions. MUTATING: Set dryRun=false to create.

chunkSize.description: Size of text chunks in characters

description.description: Description of the knowledge store's purpose

dryRun.description: If true (default), validates without creating. Set to false to actually create.

embeddingModel.description: The embedding model to use for vectorization

language.description: Primary language as a full locale code (e.g., 'en-US', 'de-DE'). Note: the project needs a configured Generative AI provider (LLM) for knowledge stores.

projectId.description: The project ID to create the knowledge store in

name: create_knowledge_store
